bond-enthalpy-ladder.alt: Enthalpy ladder for H₂ + Cl₂ → 2 HCl. Breaking the H–H and Cl–Cl bonds absorbs +436 + 242 = +678 kJ and lifts the reactants to separate atoms (2 H + 2 Cl). Forming two H–Cl bonds releases −2(431) = −862 kJ and drops to the products, which lie below the reactants: ΔH ≈ 678 − 862 = −184 kJ.
